credits.title: Vidange
credits.overview: Mireille Bertillet, a provincial judge, is transferred to Paris. She inherits a heavy file compromising high personalities.

credits.title: Long Live the Republic
credits.overview: A group of young unemployed people from Le Mans (France) decide to create a new political party.

credits.title: Captain Conan
credits.overview: The last days of World War I, Eastern front. Captain Conan, a lone wolf, a true warrior, leads a band of ruthless French fighters who love hand-to-hand combat; they are not fit for peacetime, they only feel really alive in the chaos of the battlefield.

credits.title: La Haine
credits.overview: After a chaotic night of rioting in a marginal suburb of Paris, three young friends, Vinz, Hubert and Saïd, wander around unoccupied waiting for news about the state of health of a mutual friend who has been seriously injured when confronting the police.

credits.title: Victor
credits.overview: A well brought up young man commits an irreparable yet liberating act after a failed suicide attempt.
